blocks.text: This guide provides information on how to set up Onelogin as a IdP for Private Access (ZPA).
Ensure that you have the following:

blocks.item: A Onelogin account with admin privileges.
A Private Access account with an administrator role that allows you to add an IdP Configuration.

blocks.text: To configure Onelogin as the IdP for Private Access user and admin SSO:

blocks.item: Log in to the Onelogin portal as an administrator and select Apps > Add Apps.
In the search toolbar, search for Zscaler Private Access. If you are:
Configuring the IdP for Private Access user SSO, click the Zscaler Private Access 2.0 application.
Configuring the IdP for Private Access admin SSO, click the Zscaler Private Access Administrator 2.0 application.

blocks.text: The following steps are identical for both applications.

blocks.item: On the Configuration page that appears, for Display Name make sure that Zscaler Private Access 2.0 is entered for user SSO or Zscaler Private Access Administrator 2.0 is entered for admin SSO, then click Save.
From the More Actions drop-down menu, select SAML Metadata to download the IdP's metadata file. You will need this file later in order to complete the configuration within the Zscaler Admin Console.
Go to Configuration.
For Application Details:

Log in to the Zscaler Admin Console, and complete step 2 of the new IdP configuration procedure. During this procedure, you must copy the identifier within the Service Provider URL string provided. The following is an example SP URL with the identifier highlighted in green:

blocks.text: The reference to private.zscaler.com in the following example might differ depending on your organization’s assigned cloud. To learn more, see Customizing Your Account Settings.
After you copy the identifier, you can Pause the configuration.

blocks.item: Go to the Onelogin portal and paste the identifier into the Unique identifier field.
Click Save.
Go to Users > All Users.
On the All Users page, click the user you want to assign the Private Access application to.
Click Applications, then click the New app icon.
In the window that appears, from the Select Application drop-down menu, select Zscaler Private Access 2.0 for user SSO or Zscaler Private Access Administrator 2.0 for admin SSO.
Click Continue.
In the window that appears, edit the user's attributes for login, then click Save.

blocks.text: After you have assigned the application, it appears in the user's Applications list.

blocks.item: Click Save User.
Go to the Zscaler Admin Console and complete the IdP configuration set up.

blocks.text: For Onelogin, the IdP metadata file you upload to the Zscaler Admin Console will populate the Name, Single Sign-On URL, and IdP Entity ID fields. ZPA (SP) SAML Request is set to Signed and the IdP Certificate is uploaded automatically.
After configuring your IdP, be sure to verify the configuration.
